hero.titlePrefix: The analog past of art, given a
hero.description: ARCHIVIART digitizes, preserves and organizes fragile artistic and documentary heritage — historical archives, artworks and paper catalogs — into a secure, searchable archive built to last for decades.

features.paragraph1: Art history still lives in dusty folders, artists' diaries, handwritten letters, vintage photographs and inventory registers — material that deteriorates with time, environment and accident, and that is nearly impossible to search.
features.paragraph2: ARCHIVIART transforms this vast, scattered archive into a living, secure and interconnected digital ecosystem.

pillars.title: Digitize and preserve
pillars.body: Transform fragile paper-based and historical documents into a secure, long-lasting digital archive — structured preservation designed so files never become corrupted or obsolete.

pillars.title: Organize and index
pillars.body: Locate complex information in seconds. Optical character recognition and artificial intelligence turn handwritten letters and typewritten pages into fully searchable text.

pillars.title: Promote cultural value
pillars.body: Enable museums, archives and cultural organizations to manage and share their artistic heritage in an organized, accessible and protected way.

aboutIntro.titlePrefix: A bridge between art's past and its
aboutIntro.description: ARCHIVIART exists to breathe new life into culture while ensuring its preservation — so no letter, sketch or catalog is ever lost to time.

story.title: Who we are
story.p1: We are a small team of art lovers, designers and engineers based in Italy — a country where nearly every street is an archive. ARCHIVIART was created to address a major challenge: the fragility, fragmentation and difficult accessibility of analog artistic and documentary heritage.
story.riskBody: The physical loss of heritage due to time, environmental factors or accidental events — compounded by the practical difficulty of locating a single document buried within decades of paper records.
story.p2: Our solution is to transform this vast, scattered archive into a living, secure and interconnected digital ecosystem — safeguarding historical memory while making it accessible for use today.
